_instructions: Renders the FAQ section and the FAQPage schema markup. Good FAQ content is a real SEO asset — these answer the questions merchants actually search for.

faqs.q: How much does EPAY POS cost?
faqs.a: Software plans run from $17.99/mo for a standalone terminal up to $74.99/mo for full retail. Processing is a flat 2.3% + 5¢, or 0% if you run the cash discount program. Qualifying merchants can get hardware placed at no upfront cost through the Free Placement Program.

faqs.q: What is cash discount and how does 0% processing work?
faqs.a: Cash discount posts one price and offers a discount for paying with cash. Customers who pay by card cover the processing cost, which brings your effective processing rate to zero. We handle the compliant signage and receipt language so it's set up correctly.

faqs.q: Am I locked into a long-term contract?
faqs.a: No. There's no long-term lock-in on the software plans, and the Free Placement Program is not an equipment lease.
Most installs happen within a week of approval. Our team builds your menu or catalog before install day, handles the setup on site, and trains your staff on the system.

faqs.q: Can EPAY POS work with DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub?
faqs.a: Yes. Delivery orders route directly into the POS alongside your dine-in and phone orders, so there's no separate tablet to manage.

faqs.q: Do you help me figure out if I'm overpaying my current processor?
faqs.a: Send us a recent statement and we'll go through it line by line. Most statements have fees buried in the back pages that owners have never been shown. There's no obligation attached to the review.

faqs.q: When do I get my money?
faqs.a: Batches settle to your bank account the next business day.

faqs.q: What kind of support do you offer?
faqs.a: 24/7 support. Sales is at 947-228-7226 ext. 3 and customer service is ext. 5. We're based in Troy, MI.
